answer: Juries must be diverse. Three members, no two sharing a subnet, a funder, or a recruit chain. Standing releases only after all three confirm, and that standing is the nectar every clone wants. Idle identities bleed 20 percent per epoch until nothing remains. The kernel is the rule, not the scoring. A tundra of clones cannot fill a diverse panel alone, so it waits for strangers and pays them. Cleverness does not help; the constraint is arithmetic.
